result.summary: Adds a copyright header check to the Rust lint test runner to verify that tracked C++, Python, shell, and Rust source files contain standard Bitcoin Core copyright and MIT license notices. Corrects or adds missing copyright notices across existing files in contrib, src, and test to satisfy the new rule. Also adds an executable shebang to contrib/asmap/asmap.py.
result.problem: Source files and scripts can be introduced or modified without standard copyright notices or MIT license disclaimers, and without automated enforcement in CI, these omissions must be caught manually during review.
evidence: Author cites PR #34106 review comment pointing out the lack of automated checks for copyright headers ("Followsup to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34106#issuecomment-7138103662.")
result.scope_notes: Touches 27 files, but all changes outside test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs are mechanical header comment additions or fixes and an added shebang.
result.changed_since_previous: Expands header updates to 27 files (up from 14), including adding an executable shebang to contrib/asmap/asmap.py and updating the qt/translate.cmake string generator.
result.card: Adds an automated copyright header linter to the repository test runner and updates existing files to conform. It ensures Python, C++, shell, and Rust files contain expected Bitcoin Core copyright and MIT license notices, catching omissions in CI rather than relying on manual review. The pull request also fixes missing or malformed headers across 27 repository files. It follows up on discussion from PR 34106.

risk.why: A bug in the linter would only result in false positive or false negative CI lint failures.
